releaseNotes:
<!--LANG:en-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.2 - First release

✨ What's included
- [Account] Sign in with your cdkai.cc account on the NOVA provider page. NOVA Studio creates an API key for this computer automatically, shows your balance and opens the top-up page.
- [Models] Every model on cdkai.cc in one place, with DeepSeek V4 Flash ready as the default for chat, translation and the quick assistant.
- [Privacy] No usage analytics, crash reporting or announcements are sent anywhere. Your sign-in is kept in your system keychain.
- [Source] NOVA Studio is based on Cherry Studio and released under the AGPL-3.0 license. See Settings → About for the source code.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.2 - 首个版本

✨ 包含内容
- [账户] 在 NOVA 服务商页面使用 cdkai.cc 账户登录。NOVA Studio 会自动为这台电脑创建 API Key，显示余额并可直接打开充值页面。
- [模型] cdkai.cc 上的全部模型集中在一处，默认使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 进行对话、翻译和快捷助手。
- [隐私] 不发送任何使用统计、崩溃报告或公告请求。登录信息保存在系统钥匙串中。
- [源代码] NOVA Studio 基于 Cherry Studio，以 AGPL-3.0 许可证发布。源代码见 设置 → 关于。
<!--LANG:END-->
